title: Black-sand beaches
summary: The dark sand fools the meter — shots come back muddy grey. Here's the fix.
why: Matrix metering assumes mid-gray. Black sand pushes it to overexpose — brightening sand to grey and blowing the surf.

steps.text: Set the mode dial to A
Spin the front dial to f/9
Half-press to meter — watch the top LCD

pitfalls: Sneaker waves at Reynisfjara are deadly — never turn your back on the ocean.
levelUp: Wet sand at the surf line mirrors the sky — get low with the 35mm and use the reflection as a second horizon.
